Dear Miss Yonge	
[I](/person/939) will see Theuerdank somehow though I fear I shall not be at Oxford before I go to America on the 28th.

The Bodleian dont let books out - in which they are quite right.

Cambridge U.L. does - in which they are quite wrong, though I often benefit by it. I have written to Cambridge.

When I see what the [pictures](/topic/167) look like I will be able to judge how the [book](/book/62) can be treated so as to have some novel effect.[^1]
ever faithfully yours
Alex Macmillan


[^1]: CMY had suggested that when The Dove in the Eagle\'s Nest was published in volume form it should be illustrated with pictures from Der Theuerdank (1517).
